name: weekly-cost-review
description: Weekly FinOps review every Monday 10:00 KST (01:00 UTC) - prioritised savings for the lab resource group, read-only
agentPrompt:
Run the weekly cost review for resource group rg-sre-lab using the cost-guardrail-review skill.

Focus on:
1. Container Apps whose peak usage over the last 7 days is below 40% of the configured limit.
2. Container Apps with minReplicas of 1 or more that were idle for most of the week.
3. Log Analytics ingestion broken down by table, flagging any table above 20% of total volume.
4. Resources with no activity at all this week.

Before recommending any downsize, search memory for a recent incident involving that resource. The Grubify API was deliberately scaled to 1.0 CPU / 2.0Gi during an out-of-memory incident - if you recommend reverting it, say explicitly that this would undo an incident remediation and state the risk.

Output a table sorted by estimated monthly saving with columns: Resource, Finding, Suggested action, Estimated saving, Confidence, Risk. Make no changes. End with the single highest-value action.
